messages:
Alex: Pitched a new compact header for the latency dashboard: left = time presets + custom range, center = heatmap with overlay controls, right = compare mode & export. Posting wireframe in the thread.
Priya: Nice layout. Two questions: how does compare mode work? side-by-side or overlay?
Sam: Prefer overlay with toggle to split; overlay saves vertical space. Need clear legend and opacity control when overlaying two traces.
Jordan: Accessibility note: legend must be keyboard focusable and support aria-pressed for toggles. Also color choices need contrast ratio >= 4.5:1 for small text.
Nora: UX thought: add a small smoothing control (none, 5-sample, 20-sample) for p95 spikes. Label it 'Smoothing (rollup)'. Helps when buckets are noisy.
Alex: Good—smoothing as client-side option so backend unchanged. Also add a 'Show raw samples' checkbox to overlay dots for deep-dive.
Priya: For granularity, instead of numeric buckets show semantic options: auto, per-minute, per-5min, per-15min. When auto chosen, display computed bucket count tooltip. 
Sam: API example for prod: `/metrics/latency?mode=bucketed&granularity=5m&window=6h&sample=auto` — backend will return bucket boundaries + counts + percentiles. That should cover compare and export.
Jordan: Keyboard shortcuts proposal: `g` opens granularity menu, `c` toggles compare, `e` exports CSV. Document these in a help popover.
Nora: Microcopy suggestion for sampling: `Sampling — proportion of requests included in the visualization; lower sampling may omit rare latency spikes.` Put short help icon next to it.
Alex: Visual contrast: replace red heat with sequential purple scale and overlay goal lines (SLO) as thick dashed green. Also add optional 'Invert intensity' for users who prefer dark->light.
Priya: Edge case: when window > 7d we should force sample=auto and disable high-res granularities. Warn text: `High window: showing aggregated data` with a small info pill.
Sam: Export format: CSV with columns: window_start, window_end, count, p50_ms, p95_ms, p99_ms, sample_rate. Add a downloadable permalink when you export so PMs can attach to tickets.
Jordan: A11y checklist items I will add: focus order, tabindex on interactive legend, ARIA descriptions for smoothing control, keyboard operable timepicker, contrast tokens for color scales.
ConsoleBot: Heads up — design meeting Thursday 10:00 PT. Please bring the wireframe and contrast proof.
Nora: Action items: Alex update wireframe with smoothing + compare overlay; Priya add help text copy; Sam add API contract and sample CSV; Jordan assemble accessibility checklist.
Alex: Uploaded updated wireframe: link https://files.redwood/mock/latency-header-v2.png (will attach in #design). Mock shows p50 90ms / p95 540ms / p99 1.1s with smoothing=5-sample.
Priya: Quick microcopy draft posted. Small tweak: change 'Show raw samples' to 'Show sample points' to avoid ambiguity.
Sam: Will stub server param `smoothing=none|5|20`, `compare=overlay|split`, `export=csv|json` and push to the staging API.
Jordan: Also recommend adding an 'Uncertainty' legend item when sample < 0.15: small gray chevron icon with title `Estimate: low sample`.
Alex: Great. I'll iterate and post screenshots here before Thursday. :thumbsup:
